save.text: Giveaway: at 4,200 subs winner LL1973; more at every +50 subs incl. 4,250; prize is signed D&D 5E PHB + signed cast photo.
No Critical Role next week due to SDCC; panels Thu at PetCo Park: Geek & Sundry 1–2 (Matt, Laura) and full Critical Role 4–5; no badge needed; panel will be filmed and on stream next day.
Following week: Matt and Marisha in New Zealand for Armageddon; two weeks without main story; remaining cast will stream other games/chat.
Liam is remote on Skype, currently in upstate New York near the Canadian border.
Tonight’s featured charity: GameChanger (cancer); $1 donations via Square Enix promo include Deus Ex PC code; more info at break.
Sam Riegel and Taliesin Jaffe are late due to traffic, expected shortly.
Intro video frozen; stream continuing without it.
Intro video still not working; they did a live/impromptu intro and proceeded straight to game.
Sam arrived during the intro confusion; joined at table before recap continued.
They are live on camera; only the intro video had issues. Orion was Periscoping until crew confirmed live.
On Captain Damon’s orders, the rescued halfling mage from the attacking band is locked in an anti-magic brig on the ship; her future is undecided.
Several uneventful days pass at sea toward their destination; party fully rested with spells returned.
Grog’s magical beard grows slightly (colorless, translucent); Keyleth braids it with beads/flowers; Liam later glues frayed rope to make a fake goatee while Grog sleeps (undetected).
Grog’s beard prank resolves: next morning he has a real dark brown, well-braided coarse goatee ~3–4 inches; he’s proud; prior fake rope goatee is superseded.
Weather shifts mid-6th sea day: skies cloud over to colder, gloomy northern climate; natural per Keyleth’s nature check (20).
Tiberius persuades Scanlan to trade: Scanlan agrees to swap his circlet-crown for Tiberius’s Ioun Stone after a chalk-board argument.
Scanlan accepted Tiberius’s Ioun Stone trade; stone now orbits above Scanlan’s head; touted as storing three spells without using slots.
Weather shifts to colder with first snowflakes as they near Vasselheim region.
Keyleth reveals Fire Ashari live near Vasselheim in Pyrah; as part of her Aramente she must visit headmasters; proposes visiting after the Horn mission; party agrees to back her leadership display.
Landfall: Sighted Othanzia; Vesper Timberland forest with light snow; approaching fortified city larger than Emon with layered ancient-to-modern walls and dragon-headed ballistae.
Keyleth reveals her mother left when K was ~5–6; unknown tribe/status; she’s next in line; party plans to visit her Ashari near Vasselheim and may ask about her mother.
Docking at Vasselheim: city shows rebuilt war scars; skyships rare; landing atop a mill platform; Scalebearers and Kima bring the Horn box.
Cold climate: party considers warmer clothes; Vex had previously bought winter coats; some don fancy robes over cloaks.
Scanlan stores a 3rd-level Lightning Bolt into the white Ioun Stone; stone glows greenish-blue; still costs the spell slot now, stored after rest.
Kima admits she hasn’t been with her Order “proper” for eight years; shows nervousness before meeting them.
At Vasselheim platform, group meets Scalebearer Yonn leading gray-tabarded escorts; plan to bring Horn to the Platinum Sanctuary to dispose of it; ~25-minute walk.
Vasselheim restricts arcane magic; no arcane temples/sigils; city is a holy place favoring divine magic.
Vasselheim guards display holy symbols mostly of Erathis, Avandra, Melora, some Bahamut; none of Sarenrae noted.
Vasselheim is entered only by foot as a pilgrimage; residents stay by will/divine right; rugged, muddy city with hardy folk in furs/leathers.
Tiberius casts Alter Self to appear metallic (gold) after Yonn says his red color is off-putting; warned not to use arcane openly in public.

Vasselheim is the oldest known bastion of civilization, tens of thousands of years old; holiest city with oldest temples to good/neutral deities; public arcane use is considered profane and tightly controlled.

Approaching the Platinum Sanctuary: ancient stone fortress with added ivory/silver spires; Draconic inscriptions like ‘honor, justice’; Bahamut shield-dragon symbol on marble-worn gray doors; doors open as Scalebearers approach.

Party acknowledges need to hide arcane in Vasselheim; Travis/Grog says he’ll pocket spells; Tiberius earlier altered appearance; guards flank them carrying a platinum/silver engraved box with blue sapphires (Horn’s case).
Vasselheim city guards called Bastions are civilian volunteers; about a quarter of the populace serves; patchwork armor; envoys in blue/silver robes are from Bahamut’s temple, distinct from Bastions.
Keyleth scouts as an eagle outside the walls; spots a large fast serpentine multi-form creature under the canopy; ballista fire drives it off; such attacks seem a common occurrence near the city.
Keyleth reenters the Platinum Sanctuary via arrow slit, transforms mid-entry, is confronted by Platinum Dragon guards and must persuade them she’s with Vox Machina.
Kima invokes her authority in the Platinum Sanctuary; Scalebearers immediately free Keyleth from cuffs and apologize when Kima says "She's with me."
Inside the Platinum Sanctuary: austere ancient stone fortress; air smells of dust and age yet hums with divine power; Pike senses exceptionally strong holiness.
Keyleth was cuffed by Platinum Dragon guards after reentering; escorted to main chamber; reunited with Vox Machina before Kima secured her release.
Highbearer Vord, an elderly elf and leader of the Platinum Sanctuary, greets the party; Kima kneels and he calls her his disciple; he requests the Horn container and warns not to open it.
Vord confirms the artifact is one of the Horns of Orcus via divine inspection; states it must be sealed immediately; shows strain performing the confirmation.
Platinum Sanctuary central dome art depicts creation, planes, and Bahamut battling Tiamat; temple members’ reaction confirms Tiamat still exists and is feared.

Plan: Seal Orcus Horn in Hall of the Exalt beneath the Platinum Sanctuary; lower chambers infested by subterranean spider creatures; some vault defenses accidentally activated by Scalebearer Yonn during his escape.

Star of Exaltation: divine crystal from Bahamut’s tear in the Dawn War; its chamber lies beneath the temple; the Star was expended/destroyed protecting Vasselheim ~300 years ago during a siege; chamber maintained and chosen as sealing site.

Security: Platinum Sanctuary vault is heavily guarded and under Bahamut’s gaze; not all defenses are active, but full trigger prevents entry unannounced; Scalebearers will accompany the party carrying the Horn; party must keep them safe.
Highbearer Vord insists the Horn be sealed immediately; party agrees to do it now and follow Kima to the vault area.
Vord offers 3,000 gp total; after Scanlan’s Deception 30, Vord confirms 3,000 gp available upon delivery/sealing of the artifact.
Kima will accompany the party to the vault; she leads them down two layers into a musty storage basement toward the lower chambers.
Kima uses her holy symbol to reveal a hidden stone doorway; opens to a staircase into an older vault section.
Vault Entry Room: 50x50 chamber with thick white mist from dragon-headed pillar mouths; pillars can rotate (bases have gap).
Kima admits she has not been within the vault; uncertainty about defenses inside.

Vault Entry Room trap: touching wall mist triggers spinning dragon-mouth flamethrowers; center path safe while mist cleared by Keyleth’s Gust of Wind; pillars rotate; room ~50x50 with thick mist from dragon heads.
Party split briefly by mist trap; Kima’s Scalebearers are accompanying Vox Machina through the vault; Keyleth uses Gust of Wind twice to clear central path for all to pass.
Trap sprung when Vax brushed mist; saves: Vax evades damage (Uncanny Dodge on successful save), Tiberius 12 fire dmg, Scanlan/Keyleth/Pike 24 each; trigger confirmed hazardous.
Party successfully crosses mist trap; Tiberius used tiny Prestidigitation air shield; mist refilled after Keyleth’s Gust ended.
Next chamber: circular, floor covered in many circular plates; stepping on one starts room rotating while plates piston up to ceiling repeatedly; wide 20-ft open stairway on far side.
Vax triggered plate test: acrobatics/dex saves through pistoning floor; Nat 20 avoided first crush, then hit for 40 bludgeoning when launched to ceiling; continues with successful checks.
Vax reaches stair side through rotating piston room despite heavy bludgeoning; Perception 25 spots a coin-sized hole in ceiling revealed between piston strikes.
Plan: shoot the ceiling hole to possibly stop mechanism; Vex takes the shot with Scanlan’s Inspiration (d10); attack roll totals 35.
Hole located in center ceiling where a central pillar hits; only visible intermittently as pillar retracts; shot requires ricochet angle.
Outcome: Vex’s 35-shot succeeds; arrow ricochets into ceiling slit, arcane force drives it up; grinding metal pours out, pillars scrape then halt; mechanism disabled.
Afterward: Party crosses safely; Vax injured but reaches others; group takes a short rest to spend hit dice before stream break.
Guest Taylor: co-founded GameChanger Charity after own illness; partners incl. Square; runs GameChanger Days providing games, food, scholarships; goal: hope for kids with rare diseases.
Tonight’s donations via the Critical Role 826LA link will be directed to GameChanger (confirmed by Zac/Laura).
Deus Ex promo: donate >$1 at gamechangercharity.org campaign to get a free Director’s Cut; last day is tonight; their site briefly crashed from traffic.
